data.notes: August 2026 is already anchored by major open-air electronic bookings in Brooklyn and Randall’s Island, plus arena-scale pop/R&B residencies in the NYC metro area.

events.title: Harry Styles: Together, Together at Madison Square Garden
events.summary: Harry Styles opens his Together, Together Madison Square Garden run on August 26, 2026, with Jamie xx listed as support on ticketing pages. Ticketmaster confirms multiple August MSG dates, including August 26, 28, and 29.

events.title: Bruno Mars: The Romantic Tour at MetLife Stadium
events.summary: Bruno Mars brings The Romantic Tour to the NYC metro area for four MetLife Stadium shows on August 21, 22, 25, and 26, 2026. The venue page confirms the dates, 7:00 PM showtimes, and on-sale status.

events.title: Zedd In The Park NYC
events.summary: Zedd In The Park brings a two-day electronic event curated by Zedd to Randall’s Island Park on August 14–15, 2026. The official site confirms the dates, daily hours, and VIP/ticketing information.

events.title: NoMad Jazz Festival 2026
events.summary: NoMad Jazz Festival returns August 2–8, 2026, with free mainstage performances scheduled for August 7 and 8 in Madison Square Park. The announcement confirms a week of jazz programming across NoMad and Flatiron, with lineup details still to come.

events.title: Sara Landry at Under the K Bridge Park
events.summary: Sara Landry headlines Under the K Bridge Park with Boys Noize, Godtripper (live), and Jenna Shaw on the listed Saturday date. The AXS listing confirms the 7:00 PM doors and 21+ event status.

events.title: Sammy Virji: North America Tour 2026 Part 1
events.summary: Sammy Virji brings his UK garage-driven North America tour to Brooklyn Army Terminal, with Sam Gellaitry and 33 Below listed on the AXS/DICE event pages. The event is confirmed for Saturday, August 1, 2026 at 4:00 PM.

events.title: Alesso at Brooklyn Army Terminal
events.summary: Alesso headlines an open-air Project 91 event at Brooklyn Army Terminal - Pier 4 on August 22, 2026. The DICE listing confirms the 3:00 PM start, venue, promoter, and 21+ status.

events.title: Teksupport: Cloonee (Hellbent)
events.summary: Teksupport hosts Cloonee’s Hellbent party at Brooklyn Army Terminal, a large-scale waterfront tech-house event from one of NYC’s defining electronic promoters.

events.title: Seth Troxler, Loco Dice and Victor Calderone
events.summary: Pacha New York books Seth Troxler, Loco Dice, and Victor Calderone for an all-night house and techno summit pairing international selectors with a New York veteran.

events.title: Charlotte de Witte
events.summary: Charlotte de Witte headlines Knockdown Center’s Main Hall after a prior instant-sellout Ruins takeover, making this one of August’s major techno club-room moments.

events.title: Josh Baker: DAY AND NIGHT
events.summary: UK tech-house selector Josh Baker leads a day-into-night takeover across The Ruins and Main Hall, with separate day, night, and combined tickets for a full extended dance-floor run.

events.title: The Nursery: Gerd Janson, Ron Like Hell
events.summary: Running Back boss Gerd Janson joins Ron Like Hell at public records’ outdoor Nursery, a strong Sunday house/techno booking for travelers chasing open-air selector culture.

events.title: Soul in the Horn ft. Natasha Diggs & Friends - August 21
events.summary: Natasha Diggs brings Soul in the Horn to 99 Scott, blending house, hip-hop, disco, soul, and rare grooves in a Brooklyn edition of her influential live/DJ culture platform.

events.title: Matroda Day & Night NYC Marathon by Gray Area
events.summary: Matroda headlines a Gray Area day-to-night takeover at Knockdown Center on August 14, 2026. The listing describes a two-stage format moving from The Ruins into the main hall, with special guests planned.

events.title: The Nursery: Soul Summit All Day Long
events.summary: Brooklyn institution Soul Summit takes over public records’ outdoor Nursery for an all-day soulful house session—one of the city’s most enduring Black house-music gatherings.

events.title: Claude VonStroke in The Ruins
events.summary: Claude VonStroke plays The Ruins at Knockdown Center on August 7, 2026. Resident Advisor lists the event as a house-focused show tied to his new LP Wrong Number.

events.title: OGUZ & Guests
events.summary: GRAY-AREA books Dutch-Turkish techno artist OGUZ for a daytime rooftop session with Medina and JSMN, bringing high-energy European techno into a summer Brooklyn setting.

events.title: Teksupport: Carlita (Extended Set)
events.summary: Teksupport hosts Carlita for an extended set at Sunset Park Rooftop on August 7, 2026. The Resident Advisor listing confirms the venue, promoter, and house genre billing.

events.title: AC Slater & Guests at Superior Ingredients
events.summary: AC Slater plays the Superior Ingredients roof on August 23, 2026, with local support listed as Boy Sanders and Riva + Bianca in the RA event description. The event is billed as a house-focused daytime rooftop party by Gray Area.

events.title: Project 91 Presents DJ Levi at The Rooftop at Pier 17
events.summary: Project 91 presents DJ Levi on The Rooftop at Pier 17 on August 29, 2026. The venue page confirms the outdoor rain-or-shine event, 5:00 PM start, and no-later-than-10:00 PM conclusion.
